children: to Neutral from Buy, noting that Tempus AI
, which has agreed to acquire the cancer test maker, will succeed in completing the transaction despite additional takeover interest
$1.5B deal came in July at a time when Personalis
was exploring a potential sale and was reportedly attracting takeover interest from multiple parties, including Merck

“Despite a competitive bidding process, we believe Tempus is highly likely to close its acquisition of Personalis (and at its announced terms), and thus we are not expecting a higher competitive offer to emerge,” wrote BTIG analyst Mark Massaro, removing his $16.25 per share target.
Citing an S-4 filing, Massaro added that despite receiving M&A interest from as many as five bidders, the company has picked a lower bid from Tempus
, as PSNL’s board had antitrust concerns over the higher bidder.
“At this time we do not believe a higher bidder will emerge, and we expect that the deal will close at the agreed-upon price of $16.25 per share,” added Massaro.

title: Personalis downgraded at BTIG on likely Tempus takeover
